answer.reason: The verses tell of Omri's being made king by the army, his overcoming Tibni, and his founding of Samaria.

clauses.english: was made king by all Israel in the camp after Zimri slew the king
clauses.quote: all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp

clauses.english: prevailed over Tibni, who had half the people behind him, and reigned
clauses.quote: the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni

clauses.english: bought the hill of Samaria and built the city there
clauses.quote: he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver

doubts: 2KI 8:26 and 2CH 22:2 only name Omri as Athaliah's father, so they are left out.
MIC 6:16 mentions the statutes of Omri, which is not an event, so it is left out.
1KI 16:17 (the siege of Tirzah) is folded into the account of his becoming king rather than given its own clause.
